review_text: Esewa used to be a really good and trusted app before but now it’s full of problems. Transactions don’t go smoothly anymore and every time I try to make a payment some kind of error pops up. I even registered my problem with Esewa customer care but nothing ever gets fixed even after months. Honestly I’ve lost my trust in Esewa and I even feel scared to buy anything online now thinking the payment might fail or get stuck.
